title: Exchange concepts question bank: answers
description: Correctness and explanations for every question in the questions file, matched by question_id and statement_id.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the file conforms to.

question_id.description: Matches questions[].id in the questions file.

statements.description: One entry per statement of the question, five in all.

note.description: Question-level note for difficult questions, or null. Statements are referenced as {statement_id} placeholders (e.g. {KC-01-06-2}), never by letter; a renderer replaces each with the letter that statement received.

max_points.description: Number of correct statements: the most a student can score on this question (+1 per correct selection). At least one statement is always correct.

statement_id.description: Matches questions[].statements[].id in the questions file.

explanation.description: Why the statement is true or false, including worked steps for calculations. Null if none.
